summary_en: The 77 Bank raised its interim dividend to ¥60 per share from ¥52, and revised its year-end dividend forecast to ¥60 per share from ¥52. Combined with the interim dividend, total annual dividend for fiscal 2026 is projected at ¥120 per share, implying a payout ratio of 38.2%, on track to achieve the target of 40% or higher by fiscal 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Payment (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
The 77 Bank's board of directors decided on November 12, 2026, to increase its interim dividend (mid-term dividend with record date September 30, 2026) to ¥60.00 per share from the previously forecasted ¥52.00, and simultaneously revised its year-end dividend forecast to ¥60.00 per share, also from ¥52.00. The interim dividend will be paid on December 9, 2026, with a total distribution of ¥13,469 million.

These increases bring the total annual dividend for fiscal 2026 to ¥120.00 per share, representing a payout ratio of 38.2% based on earnings guidance. This reflects the bank's stated policy to progressively raise its payout ratio to 40% or higher by fiscal 2027, funded from retained earnings. The bank aims to enhance shareholder returns and return on equity through a combination of dividend increases and opportunistic share repurchases, while maintaining financial soundness and fulfilling its public mandate as a bank.
